melodiq_notes.reset_foss_confirm: Reset all sound settings (soundfont, custom URLs, volumes) to the FOSS default?

stage.no_players: Pick a track below and set it to “Plays”.

mode_hint.learn: The song waits until you hit the right note.
mode_hint.practice: Your own tempo, sections on loop. The song keeps going.
mode_hint.perform: Original tempo, score and combo count.

stage.rotate_hint: Turn your device sideways for more room

results.weakest: You were least sure in {{section}}. Practise it on loop at 75 %, then at full speed once it sits.
results.none_weak: No section stands out. Try perform mode or another track.

leaderboard.title: Best results for this song
leaderboard.not_counted: Only a full run in perform mode at full speed counts for the leaderboard.

stage.sections_title: Bars · tap a group to open its bars · colour shows how sure you were
stage.loop_hint: Loop: tap its first and last bar (or group)
stage.loop_pick_end: Now tap the last bar or group of the loop
stage.keys_keyboard: A S D F G H J K = white keys · W E T Y U = black keys
stage.keys_drums: D cymbal · F hi-hat · J snare · K L ; ' toms (from the left) · G percussion · Space kick
stage.keys_pitch: Mouse up/down = pitch, hold to sing · arrow keys and Space work too
stage.keys_switch: Tab hands the computer keys to the next player
stage.midi_sound: Play MIDI notes through the speakers
stage.judge_percussion_note: Tambourine, cowbell, clap and other percussion have a lane of their own. Unjudged, it is only shown and played along and never counts towards score or accuracy. The phone pult has no percussion pad.
stage.midi_lost: "{{name}}" was disconnected. Plugged it back in and no notes arrive? Restart the browser (Firefox on Linux does not pick up a replugged MIDI device).
stage.server_off: No Nexumia server connected. Connect it in Settings to play songs from your library.
stage.find_scores_hint: Opens the MuseScore search. Download the score there as MusicXML (.mxl), open it under "This device" and save it to the library.
stage.find_tabs_hint: Opens the Songsterr search. Download the tab there as Guitar Pro (.gp), then add it to a song with "Manage files" or open it under "This device".
stage.load_error: The file could not be read ({{error}}).
stage.play_karaoke_hint: Plays the singing line of the song's karaoke file with its mix; no alignment needed.
stage.audio_none: No recording: the backing comes from the synthesiser.
stage.pin_bar_hint: While playing, tap exactly on the first beat of a bar: the nearest bar line moves there and the bars around it follow.
stage.not_aligned: Without alignment there is only a start point; with live music, notes and recording then drift apart.
stage.marks_mode_hint: Steady tempo suits studio and click recordings, bar by bar follows a band that speeds up or slows down, score tempo only uses the start point.
stage.quality_good_steady: Check: steady tempo of {{bpm}} BPM, the alignment looks right.
stage.quality_unsure: Check: bars {{bars}} look off. Listen there and set bar lines by hand if needed.
stage.quality_tempo: Check: the recording would run at {{percent}} % of the written tempo, so the alignment probably failed.
stage.stale_marks: These bar marks come from an older alignment. Align again and save to replace them.
stage.align_status_none: Not aligned with the recording yet.
stage.align_status_outdated: Aligned with an older version; align again for better timing.
stage.align_status_pending: Aligned on this device, not saved yet
stage.files_align_hint: Aligns the scores with the song's recording on this device. Save stores the result in the song folder.
stage.export_score: Download score in the recording's tempo
stage.players_note: Up to {{max}} players, all shown here in split screen. Players on this screen share the computer keys, MIDI or microphone (the highlighted player; Tab switches); invited players play and are judged on their own device.
stage.notes_empty: Nothing saved yet. Open a score and tap "Save to Notes library".
stage.notes_delete_confirm: Delete "{{title}}" with its folder (scores, recordings, bar marks) from the server?
stage.files_meta_locked: Title and artist come from the song's karaoke .txt; change them in Melodiq.
stage.files_recordings_hint: The song's mix and its stems are not listed here; they belong to Melodiq.
stage.files_add_hint: Sheet music (.gp, .mxl, .musicxml, .xml, .mid) or audio. Existing files are never overwritten; a file with the same name is stored as "name (2)".
stage.link_label_hint: Shown instead of the file name, e.g. Beginner or Band.
stage.rescan_hint: Reads the song folders on the server again, without a restart, and moves old Notes pieces that are not moved yet.
stage.strum_hint: Automatic: downstrokes on the beats, upstrokes on the offbeats, unless the score marks the stroke. A bar setting wins over the song-wide one.
stage.parts_stored: Hidden parts get no seat, are not offered on players' devices and do not count as parts. Names and hidden parts are stored with this score in its song folder.
stage.parts_session: Hidden parts get no seat, are not offered on players' devices and do not count as parts. This score is not in a song folder, so the settings last until another song is opened.
stage.files_zip_hint: Downloads the whole song folder (karaoke .txt, mix, stems, sheet music, bar marks, recordings) as one ZIP. Single files: the download button next to each file.
stage.files_delete_score_confirm: Delete "{{file}}" with its bar marks and name from the song folder on the server?
stage.files_delete_recording_confirm: Delete the recording "{{file}}" from the song folder on the server?
stage.files_discard_confirm: Your changes to names, title or artist are not saved yet.
stage.source_song_hint: Has a karaoke .txt: also listed in Melodiq, plays with its mix.
stage.yt_hint: The companion server downloads the recording into the song folder; the score is stored there too and plays with it. Alignment starts right away.
stage.yt_search: Search YouTube or paste a link
stage.yt_need_meta: Enter the artist and title to continue.
stage.yt_need_songs: Loading the song folders from the companion server …
stage.yt_need_video: Pick a video from the list or paste a YouTube link to download it.
stage.yt_songs_error: The song folders on the server could not be read ({{error}}).
stage.yt_plan_reuse: The song folder "{{folder}}" already has a recording; it is used as it is and linked to the score.
stage.yt_plan_into: The recording is downloaded into the existing song folder "{{folder}}".
stage.yt_plan_new: A new song folder is created for the recording.
stage.yt_queued: Waiting in the server's download queue …
stage.yt_storing_score: Linking the score to the song in the Notes library …
stage.batch_hint: Pick several score files (.gp, .mxl, .musicxml, .xml, .mid). Each goes to the song folder with the same artist and title; if that folder has no recording yet, the YouTube hit for "artist title" whose length matches the score is downloaded into it (if none does, you pick one or skip the score). Then every score is aligned to its recording. A file that names no artist needs a file name like "Artist - Title". A wrong recording can be replaced in the song's files.
stage.batch_align: Aligning the score to the recording …
stage.batch_done_unaligned: Stored in {{song}}; aligning found too few bars, align it on stage.
stage.batch_review: Waiting for you: no YouTube hit matches the score length.
stage.batch_skipped: Skipped: no recording chosen, nothing was stored.
stage.batch_skipped_none: Skipped: no recording found on YouTube, nothing was stored.
stage.review_hint: None of the YouTube hits for {{song}} is about as long as the score ({{length}}). Pick the right one or skip this score.
stage.replace_hint: The chosen video replaces the song's mix in this folder. Scores aligned to the mix are aligned again; scores aligned to another recording keep their marks.
stage.replace_locked: This song's karaoke .txt is timed to its current mix, so the mix cannot be replaced here.
stage.keys_remote: Everyone plays on their own device – their notes are judged there.
stage.learn_solo: Learn mode waits for its player – it is for one player practising alone.
stage.scope_server: Song library on the Nexumia server: shared with Melodiq and available on every device.
stage.scope_device: Only on this device: nothing here is uploaded to the server.
stage.no_results: No song matches the search and filters.
stage.open_file_hint: MusicXML, MIDI or Guitar Pro; it is not stored.
stage.import_folder_hint: Keeps its scores in this browser, also offline.

ladder.bar_done_one: {{section}} sits at full speed. One weak bar is left.
ladder.bar_done_other: {{section}} sits at full speed. {{count}} weak bars are left.
ladder.bar_done_zero: {{section}} sits at full speed. That was the last weak bar.
ladder.all_done: Practise the whole song at 50 % now? Once it goes well, try 75 % and then perform it.

pult.title: Melodiq Notes – your instrument
pult.parts_hint: Players join through the lobby and pick their part on their own device.
pult.parts_no_part: has not picked a part yet
pult.no_song: The stage has not picked a song yet.
pult.no_part: All parts are taken – pick another one when one becomes free.
pult.playing: Playing – your device judges your notes, the stage shows them.
pult.waiting: Waiting for the stage to start.
pult.loading_part: Loading your part from the stage…
pult.network: Network round trip {{ms}} ms – only the clock sync uses the network, your notes are judged on this device.

latency.title: Latency · {{source}}
latency.hint: Tap along to the clicks with what you play with: the pad below, the computer keys, your MIDI instrument or a note into the microphone. The first three clicks are for finding the beat. This measures everything at once: how late the sound reaches you and how late your input arrives. Each input has its own value.
latency.tap_no_clicks: No clicks came – is the stage open and its sound on?
latency.tap_few_taps: Too few taps on the clicks – try again.
latency.tap_uneven: The taps were too uneven – try again and tap steadily.

judgement_palette.title: Judgements
judgement_palette.hint: Every judgement has its own shape (★ perfect, ● good, ✕ miss, ▲ different note). The colour-blind palette also switches to colours that stay apart with red-green colour blindness.
